ai.title: AI Adoption
details: Developed a CAS parser proof of concept within 2 hours, then delegated it to a team member to refine, who completed the production-ready parser in 2 days for work that would typically take a month
Made strict checks in the static code analysis(SONAR) to enusre that at-least 80% coverage is must as with AI, code coverage has become easier to accomplish
Adding steering document to project so that AI knows the coding practices while writing the code, reducing time to self review and fix

wealth-mgmt.title: Wealth Management Platform
wealth-mgmt.description: Designed an in-house wealth platform by leveraging capabilities from the existing outsourced solution and incorporating additional features requested by the team.
details: Date migration of 2 lakh+ clients from outsourced vendor
Smooth transitioning for clients as well as Admins
Set up performance monitoring and alerting dashboards
